hypotheses: exactly one shared physical coordinate x
proved_bridge.tensor_admission: Arbitrary private Boolean tensor factors are admitted without changing the constant.

minimal_open_lemma.statement: In every finite adaptive restriction hierarchy, assign each x-block to its first physical revelation so that the complete signed mismatch/KL plus block charge is at most A I+bU with absolute A and b<1, without reuse across descendants.
minimal_open_lemma.why_stronger_than_restatement: It specifies a physical ownership rule, the exact local block, and a no-reuse condition; it implies GU' by a proved telescope.
